title: Tabby cat rage baits an orange cat into nonstop slap fight at home
description:
Some battles are fought where humans dare not enter.

Destiney shared this wild clip of her cats hitting peak chaos.

''I was in the bathroom when my cats crawled under the door, and the tabby one started rage baiting the orange one, and they were slap fighting," she told WooGlobe.

The tabby and the orange furball went full drama mode, claws out and tails flying, in a showdown that looked like it would never end.

Bathroom peace was officially canceled.
